specialist_skills_consulted: security-policy-specialist: Enterprise authentication requirements and SSO mandates
ldap-integration-specialist: LDAP protocol validation rules and certificate requirements

rules.rule_description: After 5 consecutive failed login attempts, user account is locked for 15 minutes to prevent brute-force attacks
rules.confidence_rationale: Explicit code with named constants (MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS=5, LOCKOUT_DURATION=15min) confirms rule
rules.business_impact: Prevents brute-force password attacks while allowing legitimate users to regain access after timeout
rules.regulatory_context: Aligns with NIST SP 800-63B authentication guidelines for account lockout
rules.implementation_notes: Lockout counter resets on successful login. Admin can manually unlock accounts via admin console.
rules.user_feedback: Confirmed accurate. Critical security rule for production deployment.

rules.rule_description: Failed login attempt counter must be reset to zero upon successful authentication
rules.confidence_rationale: Explicit code shows counter reset on successful login
rules.business_impact: Prevents permanent lockout from accumulating failed attempts over time
rules.implementation_notes: Reset occurs immediately after credential validation succeeds
rules.user_feedback: Correct. Works in conjunction with AUTH-BR-001.

rules.rule_description: System administrators can manually unlock locked user accounts without waiting for timeout period
rules.source_evidence: @PostMapping("/admin/unlock/{userId}") public void unlockAccount(@PathVariable String userId) { authService.unlockAccount(userId); }
rules.confidence_rationale: Explicit admin endpoint with role-based access control
rules.business_impact: Provides support capability to unlock legitimate users who exceeded failed attempt threshold
rules.implementation_notes: Requires ADMIN role. Logs unlock action for audit trail.

rules.rule_description: User email addresses must be unique across the entire system to prevent duplicate accounts
rules.confidence_rationale: Database constraint enforces uniqueness at data layer
rules.business_impact: Prevents duplicate user accounts and ensures email can be used for account recovery
rules.implementation_notes: Database-level constraint. Registration form validates before insert.

rules.rule_description: Passwords must be minimum 8 characters with at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit, and one special character
rules.confidence_rationale: Explicit regex pattern defines exact password requirements
rules.business_impact: Ensures password strength to resist dictionary and brute-force attacks
rules.regulatory_context: Aligns with NIST SP 800-63B password composition guidelines
rules.implementation_notes: Validation occurs on both client and server. User receives clear error messages for each missing requirement.

rules.rule_description: All user passwords must be hashed using BCrypt algorithm with work factor 12 before storage
rules.confidence_rationale: Explicit BCrypt usage with work factor constant
rules.business_impact: Protects passwords from rainbow table attacks even if database is compromised
rules.regulatory_context: Industry best practice for password storage (OWASP recommendations)
rules.implementation_notes: Work factor 12 provides strong security while maintaining acceptable performance. Never store plaintext passwords.
rules.user_feedback: Critical security control. Must be preserved in migration.

rules.rule_description: Upon successful credential validation, a new session token must be created and stored before returning to client
rules.source_evidence: Flow step 6: SessionManager.createSession(userId) → returns session token
rules.confidence_rationale: Clear data flow diagram shows session creation as mandatory step after credential validation
rules.business_impact: Enables stateful user sessions for authenticated requests across the application
rules.implementation_notes: Session token stored in Redis with 30-minute TTL. Token refresh extends expiration.
rules.user_feedback: Correct flow. Session must be created before login response.

rules.rule_description: User sessions automatically expire after 30 minutes of inactivity to reduce security exposure
rules.confidence_rationale: Explicit session timeout constant with Redis TTL implementation
rules.business_impact: Balances security (auto-logout) with user experience (reasonable timeout window)
rules.implementation_notes: Each authenticated request extends the timeout by 30 minutes. User receives warning at 28 minutes.

rules.rule_name: Password Validation Required Before Session Creation
rules.rule_description: Password must be successfully validated before creating a user session token
rules.source_evidence: Sequence diagram shows: AuthenticationManager --> PasswordValidator : validates password; alt password valid --> SessionManager : create session
rules.confidence_rationale: Phase 2 sequence diagram explicitly shows password validation precedes session creation in control flow
rules.business_impact: Ensures only authenticated users receive session tokens, preventing unauthorized access
rules.implementation_notes: Password validation failure short-circuits flow before session creation is attempted
rules.user_feedback: Critical security control. Must be enforced.

rules.rule_name: LDAP Authentication Required for Corporate Users
rules.rule_description: Corporate user accounts must authenticate via LDAP directory service; local password authentication is disabled for corporate domains
rules.confidence_rationale: Code shows explicit LDAP authentication path for corporate accounts, corporate domain detection logic present
rules.business_impact: Centralizes authentication for corporate users via enterprise directory, enables single sign-on
rules.regulatory_context: Enterprise Security Policy mandates LDAP authentication for corporate users
rules.implementation_notes: LDAP connection uses secure LDAPS protocol. Certificate chain validation required. Corporate domains: @company.com, @corp.company.com
rules.user_feedback: LDAP authentication is required by enterprise security policy, not just implementation choice. Critical compliance requirement.

rules.rule_description: LDAP connections must validate full certificate chain including root CA to prevent man-in-the-middle attacks
rules.confidence_rationale: Code shows SSL protocol configuration, but custom socket factory suggests potential certificate validation weakness. Requires verification.
rules.business_impact: Protects LDAP authentication from network interception and credential theft
rules.regulatory_context: Enterprise Security Policy requires certificate validation for all LDAP connections
rules.implementation_notes: Current implementation uses custom socket factory - needs security review. Should use standard Java TrustManager with proper CA certificate store.
rules.user_feedback: Security team needs to review TrustAllCertsSocketFactory implementation. May need remediation before migration.

rules.rule_description: All active user sessions must be invalidated immediately when user password is changed to prevent session hijacking with old credentials
rules.source_evidence: sessionManager.invalidateAllUserSessions(userId); logger.info("All sessions invalidated for user {} after password change", userId);
rules.confidence_rationale: Explicit code shows session invalidation call after password update with audit logging
rules.business_impact: Prevents unauthorized access via stolen session tokens after password change, requires re-authentication
rules.implementation_notes: User is logged out from all devices/browsers. Must login again with new password.
rules.user_feedback: Essential security feature. User reported this was missing in initial analysis - found during Phase 3 extraction.

rules.rule_name: Failed Attempt Tracking Per IP Address
rules.rule_description: Failed login attempts are tracked both per user account AND per source IP address to detect distributed attacks
rules.confidence_rationale: Code shows dual tracking (user + IP), cache key construction confirms separate counters
rules.business_impact: Detects and blocks credential stuffing attacks from distributed botnets
rules.implementation_notes: IP-based lockout threshold: 20 attempts per 15 minutes. User-based: 5 attempts per 15 minutes.
rules.user_feedback: Good catch. This dual-tracking pattern should be preserved in VNRM.

rules.rule_description: All authentication events (login success, login failure, logout, password change, unlock) must be logged to audit trail with timestamp, user ID, IP address, and outcome
rules.source_evidence: // Audit log entry: LOGIN_SUCCESS, userId={}, ip={}, timestamp={}
rules.confidence_rationale: Code comments indicate audit logging pattern, implementation uses structured logging library
rules.business_impact: Provides forensic trail for security investigations and compliance audits
rules.regulatory_context: Required for SOC 2 compliance and incident response procedures
rules.implementation_notes: Audit logs stored in separate database table with 90-day retention. PII in logs must be masked per GDPR.
rules.user_feedback: Compliance requirement. Must be comprehensive in VNRM implementation.
